displayIdentity.body: Unpaid proclamation and false apostles are contrasted. Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God’s Good News free of charge? It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.
